title: Responding to the Cries of the World Retreat
speaker: Seiu Hannah Sullivan
summary: The talk emphasizes the importance of cultivating compassion and responding to the needs of others, drawing on the archetype of Avalokiteshvara, the embodiment of infinite compassion in Buddhism and other traditions. By recognizing our interconnectedness with all beings, we can begin to understand suffering and tragedy as a shared human experience that requires kindness and care. Seiu Hannah Sullivan encourages embracing uncomfortable feelings and finding solace in the power of compassion, particularly when it comes to those we may not naturally feel empathy towards, in order to cultivate true and expansive kindness.
